name: 63. Responses -> Chat Completions Routing (Mantle datasheet + Azure DeepSeek UA) (responses-chat-routing)
description:
Two independent responses->chat mechanisms landed in PR #6326, plus the datasheet provider-matching fix underneath one of them.

1. Bedrock Mantle, datasheet-driven (core/providers/bedrock/mantle.go, core/providers/bedrockmantle/bedrockmantle.go, schemas.ModelCaps.SupportsResponsesEndpoint): a Responses request for a model whose datasheet row lists supported_endpoints WITHOUT /v1/responses is served from chat completions and converted back with ToBifrostResponsesResponse(). This only works because framework/modelcatalog/datasheet/params.go now compares the raw row provider before normalizeProvider - which folds every row containing "bedrock" (including "bedrock_mantle") onto "bedrock", so a bedrock_mantle capability lookup previously matched nothing and silently fell back to the permissive default.

2. Azure DeepSeek, user-agent-driven (plugins/compat/azure.go, plugins/compat/main.go, plugins/compat/dropparams.go, core/bifrost.go): Azure splits capabilities across its two DeepSeek endpoints - /v1/responses has web search but rejects reasoning.effort, /v1/chat/completions is the reverse - so a blanket fallback is wrong. compat's PreLLMHook sets BifrostContextKeyChangeRequestType=chat_completion when the caller is a coding harness (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) and core performs the conversion; every other caller keeps /v1/responses. There is deliberately NO datasheet-driven fallback on Azure.

Streaming on both mechanisms sets BifrostContextKeyIsResponsesToChatCompletionFallback so the chat streaming handler re-assembles Responses events; the streaming rows fail if raw chat.completion.chunk frames reach a Responses route. The Mantle streaming rows additionally pin the openai.go break on finish_reason + usage, without which a Mantle stream (which never sends [DONE]) hangs until the idle timeout.

Model choices are load-bearing: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-oss-safeguard-20b (supported_endpoints ["/v1/chat/completions"]) and bedrock_mantle/nvidia.nemotron-nano-3-30b (["/v1/chat/completions", "/v1/batch"]) both take the fallback, while bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-sol lists /v1/responses and is already covered natively by folder 33.

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-oss-safeguard-20b native /v1/responses is served from chat completions (datasheet has no /v1/responses) - responses-chat-routing

exec: // Datasheet row for bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-oss-safeguard-20b lists supported_endpoints: ["/v1/chat/completions"],
// so ModelCaps.SupportsResponsesEndpoint(true) is false and the Mantle provider serves the
// request from chat completions, converting the reply back with ToBifrostResponsesResponse().
// Before PR #6326 the datasheet lookup folded bedrock_mantle rows onto bedrock, the capability
// check silently fell back to true, and the request hit Mantle's /responses endpoint and 4xx'd.
var body = pm.response.text();
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b: served without an upstream rejection - responses-chat-routing', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'a 4xx here means the Responses request still went to Mantle /responses for a model whose datasheet lists no /v1/responses: ' + body).to.be.below(400);
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
var j = pm.response.json() || {};
var dump = JSON.stringify(j).slice(0, 400);
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b: reply is Responses-shaped, not a chat completion - responses-chat-routing', function () {
pm.expect(j.object, dump).to.eql('response');
pm.expect(j, dump).to.not.have.property('choices');
pm.expect(j.output, dump).to.be.an('array');
pm.expect(j.output.length, dump).to.be.above(0);
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b: converted response carries id / model / status - responses-chat-routing', function () {
pm.expect(j.id, dump).to.be.a('string').and.to.not.be.empty;
pm.expect(j.model, dump).to.be.a('string').and.to.not.be.empty;
pm.expect(j.status, dump).to.be.a('string').and.to.not.be.empty;
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b: usage is Responses-shaped (input_tokens/output_tokens) - responses-chat-routing', function () {
pm.expect(j.usage, dump).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(j.usage, dump).to.have.property('input_tokens');
pm.expect(j.usage, dump).to.have.property('output_tokens');
pm.expect(j.usage, 'chat-shaped usage leaked through the conversion: ' + dump).to.not.have.property('prompt_tokens');

item.name: bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-oss-safeguard-20b native /v1/responses streaming re-assembles Responses events - responses-chat-routing

exec: // mantleResponsesStream sets BifrostContextKeyIsResponsesToChatCompletionFallback and
// dispatches ChatCompletionStream; HandleOpenAIChatCompletionStreaming must emit Responses
// events, and must break once finish_reason AND usage are seen (Mantle never sends [DONE],
// so without that break the stream hangs until the idle timeout).
var body = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b streaming: stream succeeded - responses-chat-routing', function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'stream request failed: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.equal(200);
pm.expect(body, 'no SSE frames: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.include('data:');
if (pm.response.code >= 400) { return; }
var ssePayloads = body.split(/\r?\n/).filter(function (line) { return line.indexOf('data:') === 0; }).map(function (line) {
var data = line.slice(5).trim();
if (!data || data === '[DONE]') { return null; }
try { return JSON.parse(data); } catch (e) { return null; }
}).filter(function (payload) { return payload !== null; });
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b streaming: frames are Responses events, never chat.completion.chunk - responses-chat-routing', function () {
var rawChatChunks = ssePayloads.filter(function (payload) { return payload.object === 'chat.completion.chunk'; });
var responseEvents = ssePayloads.filter(function (payload) { return typeof payload.type === 'string' && payload.type.indexOf('response.') === 0; });
pm.expect(rawChatChunks, 'top-level chat chunks were emitted on a Responses route - the fallback flag was not honored').to.be.empty;
pm.expect(responseEvents, 'no top-level response.* events on the wire: ' + body.slice(0, 400)).to.not.be.empty;
pm.test('mantle gpt-oss-safeguard-20b streaming: stream reached a terminal response event - responses-chat-routing', function () {
var terminated = body.indexOf('response.completed') !== -1 || body.indexOf('response.incomplete') !== -1;

pm.expect(terminated, 'stream never reached a terminal response.completed/response.incomplete (it must break on finish_reason + usage instead of waiting for [DONE]; response.incomplete is the correct terminal when the model exhausts max_output_tokens): ' + body.slice(-400)).to.be.true;

pm.expect(body, 'an idle-timeout error was appended after the terminal event - the stream did not close on finish_reason + usage and stalled until the idle timeout: ' + body.slice(-400)).to.not.include('request_timed_out');
